policy: Corrections overlay the immutable generated run. They are AI-assisted owner adjudications, not human or native-speaker review. Semantic exceptions explicitly reject an unsupported OMW selection instead of attributing the replacement meaning to that synset.
postCorrectionGate: Replacement content must pass the same external-reference correspondence check before a distributable A2 compiler may consume this sidecar.

entries.replacementDefinition: Establecimiento donde se corta, peina y cuida el cabello.
entries.rationale: Peluquerías serve people of any gender; defining the establishment through men alone misleadingly narrows its clientele.

entries.replacementDefinition: Cubrir un suelo con baldosas, madera u otro material.
entries.replacementExample: Van a solar la cocina con baldosas nuevas.
entries.rationale: Solar means to lay flooring, not to earth electrical equipment; the example teaches an unsupported technical meaning.

entries.replacementDefinition: Ofrenda o acto ritual realizado en honor de una divinidad.
entries.rationale: Religious sacrifice is a valid sense, but appeasing a god is not its defining purpose; offerings may honor or thank a deity. This ritual sense exceeds A2.

entries.replacementDefinition: Persona con la que alguien mantiene una relación amorosa.
entries.replacementExample: Se encontró con su querido lejos de la ciudad.
entries.rationale: As a standalone noun, querido conventionally denotes a lover. The generic loved-person definition and mi querido subject construction misrepresent ordinary usage.
Maravillar means to inspire wonder or admiration, not catch someone unprepared. The example can validly mean the change amazed the guests; the verb exceeds typical A2.

entries.replacementDefinition: Resultado de sumar varios valores y dividir la suma entre su número.
entries.rationale: The example correctly uses the numerical mean, but the definition misleadingly includes any calculated value and omits averaging.

entries.replacementDefinition: Tarea breve que se hace fuera de casa, como comprar, llevar o recoger algo.
entries.rationale: A recado is an errand or task, not the brief outing itself. The example is natural and suitable for A2.

entries.replacementDefinition: Presencia o introducción de agentes perjudiciales en el medio ambiente.
entries.rationale: The definition misleadingly restricts pollution to human-produced substances, excluding such forms as noise pollution. The example is natural.

entries.replacementDefinition: Situación en la que un lugar alcanza toda o casi toda su capacidad.
entries.replacementExample: Hubo un lleno total en el teatro.
entries.rationale: Nominal lleno does not mean an abundant quantity of food. Un lleno de comida is unnatural; established noun senses concern full attendance or occupancy.

entries.replacementExample: Los análisis confirmaron que el agua era potable.
entries.rationale: Confirming a reservation expresses ratification, whereas the definition selects proving truth through evidence. That evidential sense is also above typical A2 usage.

entries.replacementDefinition: Perteneciente a un estilo artístico caracterizado por una ornamentación abundante y elaborada.
entries.rationale: Symmetry is not a defining requirement of barroco. The palace example is valid, but the architectural-style sense is specialized for A2.

entries.replacementDefinition: Hacer que alguien se sienta satisfecho o feliz.
entries.rationale: Contentar means to please or satisfy; limited satisfaction is not inherent. This verb is beyond typical A2 vocabulary.

entries.replacementDefinition: Persona que dirige o administra el trabajo o la carrera de otras personas.
entries.rationale: A manager directs or manages people or activities; controlling resources and expenses misleadingly defines the role as financial.

entries.replacementDefinition: Persona que posee una fortuna de un millón o más de unidades monetarias, o que es muy rica.
entries.rationale: Millonario is not specifically defined by wealth exceeding one million US dollars. The example and everyday rich-person sense are suitable.

entries.replacementDefinition: Relacionado con una comunidad o destinado a sus miembros.
entries.rationale: Comunitario means relating to or serving a community; merely being done by any group does not establish that meaning. The adjective is more typical above A2.

entries.replacementDefinition: Conjunto largo, fuerte y flexible de fibras o hilos unidos.
entries.rationale: Calling a rope a línea is an unnatural object definition in Spanish; cordón or conjunto de fibras would identify it clearly. The example is correct.

entries.replacementDefinition: Juego electrónico que se utiliza en una pantalla mediante una consola, ordenador u otro dispositivo.
entries.rationale: The definition misleadingly restricts video games to computers, excluding ordinary console and other device use.

entries.replacementDefinition: Ropa y accesorios usados para parecer otra persona, personaje o cosa.
entries.rationale: The definition omits dressing as someone or something else, so it also describes ordinary party clothes. The pirate-costume example is correct.

entries.replacementExample: Queda un vacío entre la pared y el armario.
entries.rationale: The definition describes literal empty space, but the example expresses emotional absence. That abstract noun usage is beyond a basic A2 treatment.

entries.replacementDefinition: Aparato eléctrico utilizado para realizar tareas domésticas.
entries.rationale: The definition omits the essential requirement that the household appliance uses electricity. The washing-machine example and level are suitable.

entries.replacementExample: La empresa entró en decadencia después de años de éxito.
entries.rationale: The decline sense is valid, but 'el edificio quedó en decadencia' is materially awkward for physical deterioration. The abstract noun also exceeds A2.

entries.replacementDefinition: Sistema y servicio de comunicación a distancia mediante teléfonos.
entries.rationale: The definition is too broad: transmitting sound over distance also describes radio and omits telephone communication. The service-sector noun is better suited beyond A2.

entries.replacementExample: La web conecta páginas y contenidos de todo el mundo.
entries.rationale: Both meanings exist, but the definition describes the World Wide Web while the example denotes one university website, creating a sense mismatch.
